_readme: Target accounts for the engagement-comments skill (see .claude/skills/engagement-comments). Handles are best-effort as of 2026-08-18 -- the drafting routine verifies each handle/post via web search before proposing a comment, so a stale handle costs nothing. Edit freely; tier: 'brand' = official company accounts (comment when they ship something relevant to knowledge workers), 'creator' = AI educators/newsletter authors whose audience overlaps FOWL AI's.
